notes.title: Nine Lives is now available to wishlist!!
notes.content:
This is honestly a dream come true... I'm shocked with all the support and love this project has gotten and I'm so proud that we got it onto steam! 

The full release is still quite a while away but we hope to bring multiple demos and playtests for you too enjoy!

[b]what is the planned first release content?[/b]
[list]
[*] 2* of the 9 planned story maps
[*] 1+ survival map
[*] Multiple new weapons
[*] Accessibility settings
[*] Full Controller support
[*] Steam achievements, stats, leaderboards, ect
[/list]
[i]story maps take a lot of effort to make, especially as 1 person. The remaining 7 future story maps will come as a free content update![/i]

[b]these may come in future updates or also on release[/b]
[list]
[*] workshop support
[*] mod tools
[*] Tons of new weapons and items
[*] Secrets ;)
[/list]
I can't wait for the day it releases and I'm excited for you to find all the secrets I hide!

- Sofy
